recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸片，骨髓小粒周圍與拖尾區布滿各階段造血細胞，夾雜脂肪空泡，看得出細胞量充足、三系造血（trilineage hematopoiesis）存在；此倍率無法細看發育異常。
features: Cellular aspirate smear with abundant hematopoietic cells spread around marrow particles
Admixed fat vacuoles of variable size within and around particles
Mixed population of granulocytic precursors, erythroid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes
No cohesive clusters of non-hematopoietic cells or sheets of uniform blasts at this power
Low magnification precludes evaluation of dysplasia or blast percentage
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous hematopoietic cells dispersed around particles containing fat vacuoles. A heterogeneous mixture of maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements with occasional megakaryocytes is seen, indicating trilineage hematopoiesis. No tumor clusters or monotonous blast sheets are evident at this magnification. Assessment of dysplasia (including megakaryocyte lobation) and blast count requires higher-power examination.

ddx.vs: Hemodilute or hypocellular aspirates show sparse cells amid predominantly peripheral blood elements and fat, unlike this densely cellular smear.
Acute leukemia replaces the heterogeneous maturing population with a monotonous sheet of blasts, which is not apparent here.
